notes: docs/NATIVE_RUNTIME_V2_SPEC.md Phase E context; training_pit/foundry PLAN elegant-bubbling-coral.md. Replaces the single flat frozen-tools file (toolcaller_v0/v1_frozen_tools.json) with named families, each grounded in a real *Tools.cs source file, so a candidate's TRAIN-time tool universe can vary in composition per example instead of being one fixed list. held_out=true families must NEVER appear in ANY training example -- they exist exclusively to build the generalization arena (a real, never-trained tool the model must call correctly from its in-context schema alone). Every tool schema below was read directly from its source file (name/description/parameters/required verbatim), not invented.
cross_agent_note: hardcoreerik, 2026-08-02: broaden the trained universe with real tool vocabularies from OTHER AI coding agents, not just TheOrc's own -- families cross_agent_claude_code (HIGH confidence: read verbatim from this session's own live tool definitions) and cross_agent_codex (MEDIUM confidence: public Codex CLI documentation, not verified against a live session -- treat as representative of the naming convention, not a byte-exact spec) were added for exactly this. Grok was explicitly requested too but is OMITTED: no verified, stable, publicly-documented tool-calling schema for a 'Grok CLI' agent was found -- this repo's own Grok usage (Tools/grok-review.ps1) is a plain chat-completions API wrapper with no agent tool-calling surface of its own to ground schemas in. Per this project's own no-invention discipline (see F:\3DModels\caseforge RESEARCH_NOTES.md's identical convention), fabricating plausible-looking Grok tool names was rejected rather than silently done -- add a Grok family here if/when a real, citable source (e.g. an actual Grok agent CLI's own tool-definition output) becomes available.

tools.name: graph_search
tools.description: Search the code knowledge graph (BM25 full-text over names + qualified names with camelCase tokenization, plus structural boosting). Returns a plain-text ranked list. Read-only.

query.description: Search terms (natural language or identifier fragments). BM25 over graph_fts.

label.description: Optional label filter: Method | Function | Class | Interface | Route | File.

file_pattern.description: Optional file path substring or wildcard filter.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Default 50, max 200.

tools.name: trace_path
tools.description: Trace caller/callee paths in the code graph to a given depth. Uses structural CALLS edges (or DATA_FLOWS when available). Returns a plain-text indented tree. Read-only.

qualified_name.description: Fully qualified name of the starting symbol (from graph_search).

depth.description: Max depth to traverse. Default 3, max 8.

mode.description: calls | data_flow. 'calls' uses CALLS edges; 'data_flow' prefers DATA_FLOWS when present.

tools.name: get_architecture
tools.description: Returns a high-level architecture snapshot from the graph: namespaces, top-degree hub nodes, routes, and aggregate counts. Read-only.

tools.name: detect_changes
tools.description: Use git (LibGit2Sharp) to find .cs files changed since base_ref (default HEAD~1), look up graph nodes for those files, and report impact sorted by degree. Includes blast-radius count of unique callers within depth 2. Read-only.

base_ref.description: Git ref or commit to diff against (e.g. HEAD~1, abc123). Default HEAD~1.

path_filter.description: Optional glob or substring to filter changed file paths (e.g. src/* or *Service.cs).

tools.name: graph_adr
tools.description: Architecture Decision Records store. action=list|get|add. list: recent 20. get: by id (full incl body). add: requires title+decision+status (proposed|accepted|deprecated|superseded); writes to DB. status is required for add.

status.description: For add: proposed | accepted | deprecated | superseded
